name: plugins
description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
one_liner: An official library of ready-made add-ons that connect the Cursor AI code editor to popular developer tools and services.
buyer: A SaaS company that makes a developer tool and wants to be easily reachable from inside AI code editors, not an end customer paying for this repo directly.
business_use_cases: A dev-tools startup builds and lists an official Cursor plugin for their product so developers can use it without leaving their editor, driving adoption.
A platform team inside a large company publishes an internal plugin so every engineer's AI editor can query internal services consistently.
A freelance developer offers a paid service building custom Cursor plugins for companies that want their internal tools wired in.

money_ideas.idea: Offer freelance 'build us a Cursor plugin' services to SaaS companies that want editor-native distribution.
As a SaaS vendor, treat your own plugin as a marketing channel that drives upgrades to paid tiers.

steal_this: Pick a popular API you already use, build a Cursor plugin for it this weekend, and submit it to this repo — it's free distribution to every Cursor user.
